text:
sam: Kicking off canary deploy for release v2.4.1 to inference-api. 10m observation window. Backout/runbook pinned here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/deploy-backout-v2 :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy started for service=inference-api | release=v2.4.1 | canary=5% | status=IN_PROGRESS
jess: noted. confirm pin policy — are we keeping the previous image pinned for an immediate rollback?
sam: Yes. Pin criteria are: latency >20% OR error rate >1% sustained for >60s. See runbook. If triggered we unroute canary and pin the previous version.
mike: Copying the rollback checklist from the runbook so it's easy to run from thread:
```
1) deployctl unroute --service inference-api --target canary
2) deployctl pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.9
3) deployctl scale --service inference-api --count 10 --tag canary
4) post release-note: rollback applied + link to changelog
```
mike: Also verify DB migration guard is closed (no schema writes). @elaine can you confirm?
elaine: DB guard: ON. no schema writes allowed during this window. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary health update | p95 latency +35% vs baseline | errors 0.2% | trend: worsening
sam: If latency doesn't trend down in 2m, I'll execute steps 1-2. I'm prepared to run unroute now.
jess: quick check of logs shows repeated KV cache misses, sample: 
```
[2026-03-20T07:12:45Z] cache_miss key=prompt_prefix size=64
[2026-03-20T07:12:46Z] response_time_ms=780 p95
```
sam: Thanks. Starting graceful unroute.
deploy-bot: action: unroute started by sam | progress: 10% -> 100% | status=COMPLETED
sam: Ran `deployctl pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.9` and confirmed stability. Drafted rollback notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-20-v2.4.1#rollback
oncall-lead: Can we schedule a short postmortem? Blameless tl;dr + perf regression hypothesis. I'll create the doc and invite relevant owners.
jess: I'll add the CI perf run that reproduced the spike to the PMR. :mag:
sam: Thanks team. Closing incident for canary — full rollout gated until perf fix and extra e2e tests added. :lock:
deploy-bot: final status: CANARY_ROLLED_BACK | rollback_time=40s | actor=sam
